**Coaching Note:**
When the opponent's king is cut off and exposed, look for queen checks that drive it into corners. After Qc2+, White's king is forced to a3 (only legal move), and the back rank is empty—Qb2 is mate. The knight on d6 looked menacing but was a distraction. Don't reflexively capture it; look for forcing checks first. This pattern—a check that traps the king into a mating net—appears constantly in tactics.
